Hi Laura,

Thanks — we signed up through the self-serve flow this morning and are excited to kick the evaluation off. Before we jump into a full product demo, our engineering manager asked if we could do a very short 15-minute technical triage to confirm compatibility with our stack (mainly to validate networking & throughput expectations).

High level: ShopHaven is an ecommerce SaaS serving ~1200 concurrent checkout sessions at peak. We want to understand latency expectations for synchronous product search/ranking calls and whether Redwood can be run in our VPC/Private deployment.

Would someone be available for a quick sync today or tomorrow afternoon PST? We can share a small sample of traffic and our infra diagram.

Thanks,
Elise

Elise — quick technical notes from my side ahead of the triage:
- For synchronous ranking/search loads, typical p95 latencies we target for open models on a single Dedicated inference replica are 30–120ms depending on model size and sequence length.
- If you plan to run in a VPC/Private deployment, we’ll need the CIDR ranges for allowlisting and any proxy/egress restrictions.
- Useful to know: expected avg token length per request and whether you will batch requests server-side.

If you can drop a small sample (CSV) and a tiny diagram of your request path, that will let us give more concrete guidance in the 15 minutes.

I can join the call at any of the times Laura suggested.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
